violations.text: No person in charge was present (with a certificate from an approved food safety managers course) as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. The establishment is to use the dishwasher to wash ONLY. All equipment and utensils to be sanitized at the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Heavy Cream was observed held at 50 degrees Fahrenheit in the lowboy cooler. The ambient temperature of the lowboy cooler was observed at 46 degrees Fahrenheit. Per staff, foods were placed in the unit 3 hours prior to inspection. Foods moved to proper refrigeration to rapidly cool. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The lowboy cooler was observed in poor repair (maintaining ambient temperature above 41 degrees Fahrenheit). The unit is to not be used to store/hold food until it can be replaced/repaired/serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine and quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the dishwasher and 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

At the time of inspection, yogurt parfaits and Liquid Egg Whites were observed held at 45 and 47 degrees Fahrenheit respectively. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per the PIC, the yogurt parfaits were recently moved to the unit from a colder refrigerator (Yogurts moved back to colder refrigeration). Due to Egg Whites observed at 47 degrees Fahrenheit and in sliding door refrigerator unit since previous day, Egg Whites were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2025

The sliding door cooler in the kitchen area was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 47 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was also observed to have gaskets that were in need of adjustment. Use of the unit for storage of Time/Temperature Control for Safety Foods is to be discontinued until serviced/repaired/observed maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2025
